name: Security Bond Attestation
description: Queries free, keyless public chain services (Blockstream, public Ethereum RPC, Solana mainnet RPC, CoinGecko prices) for the balances at this node's own EPM-derived BTC/ETH/SOL bond addresses and returns one USD-priced attestation. Chain RPC lives in WASM over the generic http capability, never in the host (owner law 2026-07-16; owner directive 2026-08-03).

methods.description: Takes this node's chain addresses ({btc, eth, sol} JSON), fetches each balance from a free public service, prices the total in USD, and returns the attestation JSON. A chain that fails to answer contributes nothing and is named in errors[] — never an invented balance.
